decisions.reason: It is a close fit with the firm's established prescription portfolio and was given its own product page, so a newly launched 2024 medicine would usually be given more time to build demand.

As a generic antidepressant outside the firm's core profile, it is more exposed to price pressure and reimbursement dependence, making it the most likely candidate for withdrawal and resource reallocation.
This close-to-core antihypertensive line has several models and its own page, which signals strategic commitment and makes an early discontinuation unlikely.

Although it was only mentioned rather than fully featured on the website, it supports the firm's aim to grow differentiated self-care and pharmacy-oriented products, so it is more likely to be retained than removed.
